title: spec
description: The front-door decomposition doc: an idea broken into small, dependency-ordered, independently-shippable tasks that deterministic code files as issues into the batch lane. The model authors it during a conversation; spec_intake consumes it.

slug.description: optional override for the spec:<slug> batch label; derived from the title when absent

filed.description: filing provenance written by `spec file --archive-dir` (#18): the spec:<slug> batch label plus the local-id → issue-ref map, so the conformance gate can find the filed issues afterward. Absent until the spec is filed and archived.

tasks.description: the task graph, in any order; spec_intake topologically orders it for filing

id.description: local id, unique within the spec (e.g. t1) — used only to express depends_on edges before real issue refs exist

body.description: the full issue body: scope, acceptance criteria, out-of-scope

depends_on.description: local ids this task depends on

pipeline.description: lane preset hint (e.g. micro/lite/full) for the batch run
